title: Combined v1: 186 pretraining + Leon's GEAR expert iteration (tokenizer-independent parts), sample-matched
description: Same weights, targets and eval as c001; stage_rl replaced by leon_rl.stage_rl: 15 rounds of a 400-target window with knapsack k (mean 32), hardest-first refill, T 1.0, fresh AdamW 135 steps/round lr 3e-4->3e-5, GEM loss beta 0.7, rarity-weighted mix. Tests whether Leon's RL, evolved on abs 3.2M models, transfers to the Lean incumbent at the harness's 192k samples.
hypothesis: Many small rounds with fresh optimizers and hardest-first targeting turn the same sample budget into more distinct solved targets; GEM keeps diversity so later rounds keep finding new proofs.

pretrain.arch: ALiBiGPT 6x384 Peri-LN, 8 heads (4 ALiBi + 4 NoPE), d_ff 1280

config.data: fork 51604b3: train.jsonl cap-6 (retention), 1,500 rl_targets sampled with the harness seed, dev half of transfer (1,108) for eval
config.eval: frozen harness stage_eval: EVAL_K 64, T 0.8, max_new 512; metric = dev solved at L_true >= 7
